applicableAreas: Buildings 6, 7, 8 and associated structures on southern portion of site near overhead electric line
findings.comment: Surveyed elevations of overhead electric conductors are not included on building elevation sheets, and horizontal sky-to-ground clearance dimensions from the outer conductor to building faces are not dimensioned on plans. No building elevation sheets are provided that show the vertical relationship between the conductor and building features. Applicant must submit surveyed building elevations showing conductor locations with clearance dimensions to demonstrate compliance with the 7.5-foot minimum horizontal sky-to-ground clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: Building projections near overhead electric line on southern portion of site
findings.comment: Section and elevation views showing building projections (overhangs, balconies, roofs, eaves) with clearance dimensions from the outer conductor are not provided. Plans must include detailed sections showing both the 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearance requirements from outside conductor to outermost edge of all building projections.

applicableAreas: Buildings and structures adjacent to overhead electric easement on southern property boundary
findings.comment: Clearance dimensions verifying that buildings maintain minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from overhead electric facilities in the easement are not dimensioned on plans. Applicant must provide surveyed setback distances and elevation data demonstrating that permanent structures maintain required clearances as a binding, permanent requirement distinct from any temporary construction clearances.

applicableAreas: All buildings proposed within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets containing surveyed conductor elevations or clearance dimension annotations are included in the site plan. This is a required document to verify compliance with horizontal and vertical clearance requirements. Applicant must provide registered surveyor elevation drawings showing overhead conductor locations and clearance dimensions to all building faces and projections.

applicableAreas: Buildings 6, 7, 8 and other structures near overhead electric line
findings.comment: Section and enlarged plan detail exhibits showing dimension lines from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of buildings and building projections are not provided. Plans must include detailed cross-sections with clearance dimension annotations (measured from outside conductor, not pole centerline) to buildings, overhangs, and other projections to verify compliance with both horizontal sky-to-ground and radial clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Wooden privacy fences proposed on site near overhead electric line
findings.comment: Fence alignment dimension annotations showing clearance from outside conductor are not provided. Plans show wooden privacy fences (noted on landscape plan as H.6 pattern) but lack clearance dimensions verifying the 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from the outer conductor. Applicant must provide plan view and section details with dimensions from conductor to fence alignment.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls along southern property boundary near overhead electric line
findings.comment: Section views showing clearance dimensions from the outermost electric line to the retaining wall are not provided. Retaining walls are shown on grading and landscape plans along the southern boundary where the overhead electric line is located. Plans must include detailed cross-sections with dimension annotations verifying the 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from the outer conductor to the wall face.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls along southern property boundary
findings.comment: Section exhibits with dimension annotations from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of retaining walls are not included. Although wall plans and details are provided on Sheets 38 and 39, these sections do not show the overhead electric conductor or clearance dimensions required to verify compliance with the 7.5-foot minimum clearance requirement. Applicant must provide sections showing the conductor location and clearance dimensions to wall faces.

applicableAreas: Driveways and parking areas on southern portion of site near overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Vertical clearance dimensions from the lowest point of the overhead electric facilities (including any attachments) to finished driveway grade are not shown on grading plans or section views. If driveways are located beneath or adjacent to the overhead line, plans must include sections showing mid-span clearances verifying the minimum 16-foot (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot (areas with truck traffic) vertical clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: Vehicle parking and display areas on southern portion of site
findings.comment: Vertical clearance dimensions from overhead electric lines to parked vehicles are not provided on site plans. If parking areas are located beneath or adjacent to the overhead line, plans must include notes and section views specifying the minimum vertical clearance (16 feet for parking without truck traffic or 18 feet with truck traffic) and dimensioning from the lowest overhead conductor to finished parking elevation.

applicableAreas: All site features near overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: No clearance dimension annotations are shown on plans. Where clearance dimensions are eventually provided, they must originate from the outside conductor (the actual electric wire), not from the utility pole centerline or pole structure. On multi-conductor installations, the outermost conductor may be several feet offset from pole center. All future clearance annotations must clearly show dimension lines extending from the outside conductor to the outermost edge of structures and site features.

Clearance verification for trash enclosures or receptacle locations beneath or near overhead electric facilities is not provided. If trash collection areas are located beneath the overhead line, plans must verify the 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance accounting for the height of trash bins when raised during collection service, and provide dimension annotations showing adequate clearance from the outer conductor.

applicableAreas: Entire site, specifically buildings and structures on southern portion near overhead electric easement
findings.comment: Cannot verify from available plans whether customer facilities are installed directly under or over the overhead distribution line, which is prohibited regardless of clearance distances per UCM § 1.10.3. The overhead electric line characteristics (distribution vs. transmission, voltage level, exact routing path) are not clearly identified on plans with sufficient detail to determine if any structures violate the prohibition against facilities beneath/over distribution lines. Applicant must provide detailed utility plans identifying the overhead line type and voltage, showing its exact routing in plan and profile, and confirming no structures are positioned directly beneath or above it.

Clearance dimensions verifying that water meters maintain the minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from the outside conductor of existing overhead electric service drops are not provided. If water meters are located on the site, utility plans must show their locations with clearance dimension annotations from any overhead electric service lines.

Clearance dimensions verifying that water lines maintain minimum clearance from existing or proposed overhead electrical distribution facilities are not shown on utility plans. Utility plan and profile sheets must include clearance dimension annotations showing the horizontal and vertical separation between water line routing and overhead electric facilities.

applicableAreas: Buildings and site features with proposed elevations ranging from 683 to 687.5 feet on southern portion near overhead line
findings.comment: Registered surveyor mid-span clearance data showing overhead electric conductor elevations is not provided when vertical clearances between overhead facilities and proposed site features (buildings with FFE ranging from 683 to 687.5 feet, driveways, parking) appear to be marginal or insufficient. If clearances appear less than required minimums, applicant must provide surveyed data showing conductor elevation and mid-span measurements confirming adequate vertical clearance from the outer conductor to all site features at their highest points.

applicableAreas: Trees proposed within clearance distance of overhead electric line on southern portion of site
findings.comment: Lateral distance dimensions from proposed tree locations to overhead electric conductors are not shown on landscape plans. Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors (voltage <60kV) are not verified to be from the Utility Compatible Shade Trees list (ECM Appendix F, species marked 'UC'). Landscape plan must include: (1) measurement of lateral horizontal distance from each tree to the outer conductor; (2) species verification against ECM Appendix F for utility-compatible designation if trees are within 10 feet of distribution conductors or 50 feet of transmission conductors per UCM § 1.10.10.4; and (3) confirmation that only utility-compatible trees are proposed within required clearance distances.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads shown on electrical design plan
findings.comment: Vertical clearance dimensions from overhead electric lines to the top of transformer equipment are not shown on utility plan section views. If transformers are located beneath or adjacent to overhead electric facilities, plans must include section views dimensioning the vertical clearance from the lowest point of overhead conductors to the highest point of transformer equipment to verify the minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: Entire site with proposed construction near overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Plans do not include required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003. A note must be added to the Cover Sheet or General Notes requiring 48-hour advance notification to Austin Energy before any construction, excavation, or work activities begin in proximity to overhead electric facilities.
